title: Siege of Jacmel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Jacmel", at revision 1375560888, opens: "The Siege of Jacmel was a four-and-half month long siege that took place during the War of the South, a sub-war of the Haitian revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q140288692, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege during the War of the South in Haiti (1799–1800)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
